about: CONTROL Resonant's Aberrant forms. Each row becomes one Elden Ring weapon: the base weapon row lends its moveset and model, the mod overwrites its stats, skill and text.

rows.name: Aberrant: Flurry
rows.info: The Aberrant split into twin blades. Fast, close and cruel.
rows.caption:
Primary form of the Aberrant, Dylan Faden's shifting weapon.
It answers resonance with speed: short reach, rapid cuts and a keen eye for weak points.

Combo finisher: Split Pivot.

rows.name: Aberrant: Slash
rows.info: The Aberrant drawn into a long curved edge that reaps whole crowds.
rows.caption:
Primary form of the Aberrant.
Wide sweeping arcs that catch every foe around you.

Combo finisher: Spin Edge.

rows.name: Aberrant: Slice
rows.info: The Aberrant as one honed edge, made for a single target.
rows.caption:
Primary form of the Aberrant.
Heavy single-target cuts that punish an exposed back.

Combo finisher: Wide Edge.

rows.name: Aberrant: Crush
rows.info: The Aberrant swollen into a slow, crushing mallet.
rows.caption:
Secondary form of the Aberrant.
Slow, enormous blows that break guards and stagger the strong.

Combo finisher: Concussive Beatdown.

rows.name: Aberrant: Drill
rows.info: The Aberrant twisted to a point that bores into its target.
rows.caption:
Secondary form of the Aberrant.
Directed, sustained thrusts that grind through defenses.

Combo finisher: Uppercut Surge.

rows.name: Aberrant: Extend
rows.info: The Aberrant unspooled into a long chain that reaches far.
rows.caption:
Secondary form of the Aberrant.
Reach beyond any blade; keep your distance and still strike.

Combo finisher: Split Orbit.
